snippet.title: Lovely Sweet Dream (Yume Nikki Fangame) | Full Gameplay | A charm for wonderful dreams | All Endings
snippet.description:
Lovely Sweet Dream is an RPG maker game where the charm you've bought from a grandma is said to give you wonderful dreams. You've entered its world and discovered that you're not the only one who can't leave it!

SP: I believe I haven't explored the dream world so much. I highly recommend playing it! You can also check the developer's walkthrough here: https://yumenikkifg.fandom.com/wiki/Lovely_Sweet_Dream.
SP1: You'll see some lag in this video - that is because my PC is old. I hope you'll understand. Thank you!
